title: Farewell My Concubine
desc: A sprawling, visually magnificent epic spanning fifty years of Chinese history, told through the intertwined lives of two Peking opera actors.

title: To Live
desc: A family struggle to survive through a tumultuous period of Chinese history, from the 1940s through the 1970s.

title: Let the Bullets Fly
desc: A bandit posing as a mayor enters a provincial town, sparking a battle of wits with a local mob boss.

title: In the Mood for Love
desc: Two neighbors form a strong bond after suspecting their respective spouses of extramarital activities.

title: Chungking Express
desc: Two melancholy Hong Kong policemen fall in love: one with a mysterious underworld figure, the other with a server at a late-night restaurant.

title: Happy Together
desc: A turbulent, passionate relationship between two men from Hong Kong unfolds against the backdrop of Buenos Aires.

title: Kung Fu Hustle
desc: In 1940s Shanghai, a wannabe gangster seeks to join the notorious Axe Gang, sparking a war in a hidden kung fu slum.

title: Shaolin Soccer
desc: A former Shaolin monk reunites his brothers to apply their superhuman martial arts skills to play soccer.

title: Infernal Affairs
desc: A game of cat-and-mouse between an undercover cop in a triad and a triad mole in the police force.

title: Eat Drink Man Woman
desc: A master chef in Taipei communicates with his three adult daughters through elaborate Sunday dinners.

title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
desc: A young warrior steals a legendary sword, sparking a high-stakes pursuit across breathtaking landscapes.

title: The Thirteenth Floor
desc: In Los Angeles, a wealthy man, known as Mr. Fuller, discovers a shocking secret about the world he lives in. Fearing for his life, he leaves a desperate message for a friend of his in the most unexpected place.

title: Ashes of Time
desc: Ouyang Feng is a heartbroken and cynical man who spends his days in the desert, connecting expert swordsmen with those seeking revenge and willing to pay for it. Throughout five seasons in exile, Ouyang spins tales of his clients' unrequited loves and unusual acts of bravery.

title: Dear You
desc: Grandma Ye Shurou from Chaoshan lived a simple life, enjoying her twilight years. Her grandson, Xiaowei, burdened by debt, secretly traveled to Thailand to find his rumored billionaire grandfather, Zheng Musheng. However, Xiaowei returned with shocking news: his grandfather was long gone, and the person with whom Grandma had exchanged love letters was a complete stranger. As Xiaowei investigated, a love affair hidden for half a century suddenly surfaced, striking Grandma's heart.

title: He's a Woman, She's a Man
desc: Wing is a devoted fan of popular singer Rose who is involved in a topsy-turvy relationship with her charismatic producer Sam. Willing to go to any length to meet Rose, the willowy Wing disguises herself as a man, and with a twist of fate is chosen to be the next budding star for the record company.

title: Yi Yi
desc: A Taipei family faces personal and moral uncertainty as everyday events test their relationships and sense of purpose.

title: Moon
desc: With only three weeks left in his three-year contract, Sam Bell is eager to return to Earth. Stationed alone at a Moon-based facility with his computer assistant GERTY, an unexpected accident sets off a series of unsettling events that shake his isolation.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
desc: The Grand Budapest Hotel tells of a legendary concierge at a famous European hotel between the wars and his friendship with a young employee who becomes his trusted protégé. The story involves the theft and recovery of a priceless Renaissance painting, the battle for an enormous family fortune and the slow and then sudden upheavals that transformed Europe during the first half of the 20th century.

title: Those People
desc: On Manhattan's gilded Upper East Side, a young gay painter is torn between an obsession with his infamous best friend and a promising new romance with an older foreign pianist.

title: Little Miss Sunshine
desc: A family loaded with quirky, colorful characters piles into an old van and road trips to California for little Olive to compete in a beauty pageant.

title: Taekwondo
desc: Fernando is on holiday with his closest male friends in a beautiful country house in a suburb of Buenos Aires. On their own without their girlfriends in a “men only” environment, the hunky young studs bask in the hot sun, play in the pool, smoke pot, and drink, most often semi-clad or naked. In this freewheeling and testosterone-infused environment, they talk of their desires and strengthen their individual bonds.

title: Chang'an
desc: A few years after the Anshi Rebellion, Tang dynasty military commander Gao Shi suffers a defeat in a battle threatening Chang'an. Trapped in the besieged city, he recalls his lifelong friendship with the acclaimed poet Li Bai.

title: Journey to the West
desc: Tang Zhijun, an editor of a science fiction magazine, attempts to find signs of an alien civilisation. When a strange young man claims to have received instructions from aliens, Tang and his team follow him in search of extraterrestrial creatures.

title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
desc: The Fantastic Mr. Fox, bored with his current life, plans a heist against the three local farmers. The farmers, tired of sharing their chickens with the sly fox, seek revenge against him and his family.

title: Project Hail Mary
desc: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
desc: Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.
